spec.name: Customer home

PetsStrip (PetAvatarCard x n + Add a pet)

Upcoming = bookings + appointments + daycare days of this customer that are not finished and not in the past, sorted by start; appointment statuses map onto the one lifecycle for the badge.
Service tile: no active pets -> AddAPetFirst modal (R-A01); otherwise navigate to /app/hotel, /app/grooming, /app/daycare when that route exists, else a "coming soon" toast.
Location chip opens a picker; choosing sets LocationProvider.setLocationId and customers.home_location_id (R-X23).
Pet card status: petApproval(pet, petVaccineSummary()) (R-A04, R-X20); warning triangle for needs_details / expired.
Bell badge = unread notifications for the user.
notes: In Home is not a tile (D-003: out of scope; inquiry via chat).
Hero uses a brand gradient until a licensed photo exists (open question 116).

spec.name: Sign in
spec.purpose: Customer sign in with email + password, show / hide password, remember me, forgot-password link, friendly errors, lockout after repeated failures, and email verification on first sign-in when it is still pending.
logic: authService.signIn: normalise email, compare password hash, count failed attempts, lock for policy.lockMinutes after policy.maxFailedAttempts (R-X31).
Unknown email and wrong password give the same message (R-X34).
email_verified = false opens OtpVerifyModal; "Skip for now" still signs in (R-X33).
Success: switchUser(user_id), toast, navigate to ROLE_HOME (customer /app).
Already signed in: show Continue / Use another account.
integrations: Email / SMS code delivery (mock: code shown in-app)

spec.name: Front desk today
spec.purpose: Run the day at one location: arrivals, departures, in-house and daycare counts, rooms free tonight, balances due and vaccine blockers, then the reservations of the selected day with one-click check-in / check-out (PIN-gated changes open the approval modal).
layout: StatTiles (arriving, departing, in house, daycare, rooms free, pending vaccines, balance due, grooming)
NeedsAttention (no room, vaccine issues, balance due today)
DayTabs (All / Arriving / Departing / Staying / Daycare / Checked out)
logic: bucketOf(row, day) groups rows with dayBucket() (R-I05); daycare days form their own group.
Rooms free tonight = availabilityByType(day, day+1) per room type (R-X03).
Quick action = natural next transition (Check in / Check out / Confirm); check-in without a room opens the room picker first (R-X05).
transitionNeedsPin() decides whether PinApprovalModal opens; every change writes booking_events + audit_log.

spec.name: Grooming day view
spec.purpose: Run the grooming day at one location: groomer columns tinted by working hours, appointments by time, flags for vaccines / payment / unconfirmed, column order-colour-hide per user, click a slot to book, drag to reschedule.
layout: GroomingDateNav + filters (groomer, status) + view toggle (Day / Board / Agenda)
GroomDayGrid (time x groomers, now line, capacity shading)
logic: Card label R-G20 "Owner Last, PET; Breed; Package Size"
Vaccine flag from petVaccineSummary (R-A11)
Grid hours from location hours ±1h; column tint from employees.working_hours
Over-capacity rows when overlaps > capacities.grooming (R-G21)
Column prefs upsert to groomer_column_prefs per user + location (R-X62)
Drag / slot click writes appointments.starts_at + groomer_id (audit)
notes: Replaces the F-30 stub at /desk/grooming.
Phones: horizontal scroll with sticky time column (D-016).

spec.name: Staff notifications
spec.purpose: Notifications for the signed-in staff user: vaccine proofs submitted, new app bookings, payments, messages, reviews. Unread / all tabs, kind filter, mark read on open, mark all read; the TopBar bell shows the unread count.
layout: PageHeader (tabs, kind filter, mark all read)
logic: where user_id = session user; unread first.
Rows visible while the list was open are marked read on leave (R-X78); the dot toggles read/unread.
relativeTime() (R-M08); kind vocabulary (R-M07).

spec.name: Owner dashboard
spec.purpose: The owner's morning view: revenue today and this month, dogs in house, grooms and daycare today, occupancy per room type, a revenue chart over 7 / 30 days or 12 months, today's schedule and an attention list (bookings waiting, feedback, reviews).
layout: KPI tiles (revenue, in house, grooms, attention)
Revenue chart (stacked card / cash, range switch)
logic: Revenue = paid payments by paid_at day / month, split by method.
In house = bookings.status checked_in; arriving / departing via dayBucket(today).
Occupancy tonight = bookings that staysOn(today) per room_type vs active rooms.
Location scope from useLocation().scope; owner may pick All locations (R-X45).

spec.name: Ops manual cover
spec.purpose: Business operations manual cover: what the manual is, the reading path for the current role with completion ticks, the role x chapter matrix, and every chapter by part. Chapters come from docs/ops-manual/en/*.md at build time.
logic: chaptersForRole(role): audience labels in front matter (all staff, front desk, groomer, manager, owner).
Completion = training_completions rows of the signed-in employee.
readingMinutes = words/180 + figures + directives.

spec.name: Reports & analytics
spec.purpose: Revenue by week / service / location, occupancy per night with RevPAR, bookings funnel by status and source, groomer utilization and package mix, customers with lifetime value and balances; CSV export per tab.
layout: Funnel: KPIs + status bars + source chart
Groomers: KPIs + utilization meters + package mix
logic: Revenue = totals of confirmed / checked_in / checked_out (done for grooming) records whose date falls in the range; cancelled and no_show excluded.
Occupancy % = stays that staysOn(day) / active rooms; RevPAR = room subtotal / (rooms x days).
Groomer utilization = booked minutes / (working days x 8 h).
CSV contains exactly the rows behind the active tab (R-X45).

spec.name: Company & locations
spec.purpose: Company profile (name, legal name, address, contact, tagline) and the list of locations with hours, capacities, room and staff counts; entry to the add-location flow.
layout: Locations grid (cards with hours summary + capacities)
logic: Company profile lives in settings.key = company; defaults from src/tenant/locations company constant.
summarizeHours() compresses the weekly hours into ranges.
useAdminCrud(): insert / update / remove write an audit_log row with the diff (R-X41).

spec.name: Add location
spec.purpose: Four-step flow that creates a location: details, opening hours, capacities, review. Inserts one locations row and four capacities rows; nothing else is needed for the new store to appear everywhere.
logic: Slug auto-derived from the short name; must be unique and [a-z0-9-].
Default hours match Encino / Westwood (R-K02).
Create = insert locations + 4 capacities, audited, then navigate to A-11.

spec.name: Location detail
spec.purpose: Edit one location: identity, weekly opening hours, capacities per kind, holidays and closures, danger zone (PIN-gated delete).
logic: Hours save as locations.hours { weekday: { open, close } | null }.
Capacity edits update or insert capacities rows per kind.
Holiday dates exclude long-stay discounts (R-E15).

layout: KPI tiles (rooms, per type, occupied tonight)
logic: Occupied tonight = bookings.room_id of stays that staysOn(today).
Position applies to penthouses only; bottom rooms fit dogs over 30 lb (R-E09).

Read-only page; edits happen on A-20..A-26.

taxable_as picks the tax rate column.

spec.name: Providers

secret_masked keeps at most the last 4 characters.
Payment provider name from src/payments defaultPaymentProvider.

spec.name: Employees
spec.purpose: Staff records at the current location: add / edit (job, department, login user, role, location, status, colour, groomer / handler flags), set or reset a PIN with manager approval.
layout: KPI tiles (active, groomers, handlers, with PIN)
Staff CrudTable (status / department filters, PIN column)
logic: Role shown from the linked users row; saving with a login updates users.role / location_id.
New PIN must be 4-6 digits; stored as hashPin(); a manager / owner PIN approves the change and an audit row pin.reset is written (R-X43).

spec.name: Roles & permissions

Toggle updates / inserts the permissions row (audited).
Owner cannot drop settings.write; super_admin column is locked.

spec.name: Side menus per role
spec.purpose: Owner decides which menu categories each role sees (D-014); stored in roles.menu as category -> visible, with a live preview of that role's sidebar.
logic: Routes with nav and the role in roles[] are grouped by navGroup; Overview is always on.
Preview greys hidden categories; DesktopShell applies roles.menu once wired (R-X40 in_dev).

spec.name: Reviews
spec.purpose: Moderate customer reviews at the current location: publish, archive, back to pending; average published rating.
logic: Status changes need reviews.moderate and are audited.
Published can return to pending or be archived (R-X47).

logic: Open -> status seen when new.
Save reply keeps status; Mark done -> done.
Page code links to the route from the registry.

spec.name: Approvals log
spec.purpose: Every manager-PIN approval (who asked, who approved, action, record, details) for the current location, exportable as CSV.
logic: Rows are written by PinApprovalModal before the gated action runs.
CSV export needs reports.export and contains the visible rows (R-X45).

spec.name: Audit log
spec.purpose: Who changed what: every audited insert / update / delete with a before -> after diff, filterable by table and action, exportable as CSV.
layout: Audit DataTable (table / action filters, diff column)
logic: Location-scoped rows plus global (location_id null) rows when one location is selected.
Diff renders key: old -> new for up to 6 keys.

spec.name: Backups & export
spec.purpose: Download the whole mock database (or a single table) as JSON, keep an export log, reseed with manager approval.
logic: Snapshot = data.list() of every TableDef; file petrock-export-<date>.json; a backups row logs it.
Reset to seed opens PinApprovalModal then data.reset().

spec.name: General settings
spec.purpose: Key / value setting groups: boarding (enclosure names, charge by, windows), invoices (numbering, footer), general (time format, slot, weight unit, defaults), brand (logo, font, colours), security & prompts.
logic: Each group is one settings row (key) whose value merges defaults with stored values.
Save merges the form into the row value and audits it.

spec.name: Staff PIN login
spec.purpose: Fast staff sign-in with a 4-6 digit PIN; lands on the role home and pins the location for front desk / groomer.
logic: findByPin(pin, holders): hash the PIN (FNV-1a mock) and match employees.pin_hash merged with demo holders.
On success switchUser(userId) and navigate to ROLE_HOME[role]; the LocationProvider pins location-scoped roles.
Wrong PIN clears the pad and shows an error; the real backend rate-limits.

spec.name: Welcome
spec.purpose: First screen of the customer app: brand, one-line promise, Create account, Sign in, staff PIN link; the first visit opens the three-slide "How Petrock works" intro.
layout: Already have an account? Sign in
logic: If a customer is already signed in show "Continue as {name}" first.
Intro shown once per browser (localStorage petrock.auth.introSeen), re-openable from "How Petrock works".
Right-hand Figma variant chosen (New to Petrock? + button) per open question 12.

spec.name: Create account
spec.purpose: Sign-up form: first / last name, email, optional mobile, usual Petrock location, password with live strength meter, terms and optional marketing consent; creates users + customers + auth_credentials and sends the verification code.
layout: Already have an account? Sign in
logic: Validate on blur and on submit: names required, email shape, US phone shape when given, password policy (R-X30), terms accepted (R-X38).
Duplicate email (auth_credentials or users) -> error with a Sign in link (R-X36).
authService.signUp inserts users (role customer), customers (home_location_id), auth_credentials (email_verified false, terms_accepted_at), logs sign_up and issues a verify_email code.
Navigate to C-04 with email + next=/auth/welcome.
integrations: Email / SMS code delivery (mock: code shown in-app)

spec.name: Verify code
spec.purpose: One-time code entry after sign-up (or from a deep link): six boxes, auto-verify on the last digit, resend with cooldown, expiry; on success the session switches to the new customer and continues to the next screen.
logic: Query: email, purpose (verify_email | sign_in), next (default /auth/welcome).
authService.verifyCode: latest live code for email + purpose; expired -> new code needed; attempts >= policy.maxCodeAttempts -> consumed; match -> consumed, credential email_verified = true (R-X32).
Resend: issueCode consumes the previous live code; cooldown policy.resendSeconds.
Verified: switchUser(credential.user_id), navigate(next).
integrations: Email / SMS code delivery (mock: code shown in-app)

spec.name: Forgot password
spec.purpose: Request a password-reset code by email without revealing whether the account exists; continues to C-06.
layout: Sent state: FormAlert + Enter code button
logic: authService.requestPasswordReset: log the request; issue a reset_password code only when the email is known; the UI shows the same confirmation either way (R-X34).
Email prefilled from ?email= (C-07 link).
integrations: Email / SMS code delivery (mock: code shown in-app)

spec.name: Reset password
spec.purpose: Enter the emailed code and a new password (strength meter); clears any lockout and marks the email verified.
logic: authService.resetPassword = verifyCode(reset_password) + update password_hash, password_changed_at, failed_attempts 0, locked_until null, email_verified true (R-X31).
Password must pass the policy (R-X30); code errors clear the boxes.
Success: toast + navigate to C-02.
integrations: Email / SMS code delivery (mock: code shown in-app)

spec.name: Account locked
spec.purpose: Shown after too many failed sign-ins: explains the pause, counts down to when sign-in reopens, offers password reset and a way to reach the front desk.
logic: Query ?email= -> auth_credentials.locked_until; countdown from useCountdown; at 0 the Try again button navigates to C-02.
Reset password goes to C-05 with the email prefilled; a reset clears the lock (R-X31).

spec.name: Account created
spec.purpose: Success screen after email verification: greets the new customer, lists the three next steps (add dogs, upload vaccines, book) and opens the app; the intro carousel is available again here.
logic: Reads the session user (switched by C-04) and the customers row for the first name and home location.
Not signed in -> friendly redirect card to C-01.

spec.name: Sign out
spec.purpose: Confirm sign-out, log the event, clear the session to the public visitor and offer sign-in again or the hub.
layout: Signed-out state with Sign in / Create account
logic: Sign out = authService.signOutEvent + SessionProvider.signOut() (session becomes usr_public) + clear petrock.auth.remember.
Already public -> show the signed-out state directly.

spec.name: Grooming & Spa
spec.purpose: Entry point of the Grooming & Spa service for a pet parent: what it is, live price menu by package and size, spa add-ons, upcoming orders, and the Book now call to action (D-004 / D-011: one service, Spa is a package category).
logic: Customer = customers.user_id == session user (super admin falls back to the demo customer).
Upcoming = orders in requested / pending_vaccines / confirmed / checked_in starting later than 3 h ago, first 3.
Price menu highlights the first pet's size tier (sizeFromWeightLbs).
Book now with zero pets opens the Add-a-pet modal; otherwise resets the grooming draft and opens C-51.
notes: Reached from the Home service tile (C-10) at /app/grooming.

spec.name: Choose pet & package
spec.purpose: Step 1 of the Grooming & Spa order: pick the pet and the package; prices are the package table values for that pet's size tier.
layout: PetChoiceStrip (single select, other pets in the order disabled)
logic: Draft item = { petId, packageId, addonIds } stored in localStorage petrock.draft.grooming; current index points at the pet being configured.
Price = packagePrice(pkg, pet.sizeTier); minutes = packageMinutes.
Pets already in the order cannot be chosen twice.
Next enabled when pet and package are set.

spec.name: Add-ons
spec.purpose: Step 2: toggle spa add-ons for the current pet (price and added minutes by size), see the running total, and add another pet to the same order.
layout: Other pets in the order (Chips, removable)
ServiceFlowFooter (Groom another pet | Next, running subtotal)
logic: addedMinutes = added_minutes_l for L/XL/Giant, else added_minutes_sm (R-G13).
Running subtotal = quoteOrder(items) before tax.
"Groom another pet" appends an empty item and returns to C-51 when a pet is still unbooked (R-G16).
Redirects to C-51 when the current item has no pet or package.

spec.name: Choose date & time
spec.purpose: Step 3: location, date, groomer and start time. Slots come from location hours, grooming capacity and existing appointments; the Figma export had no slot screen (open question 54) so this is designed fresh.
layout: Groomer select (any / named groomer at that location)
logic: orderMinutes = longest per-pet chair time (pets are groomed in parallel up to capacity).

computeSlots(): 30-min steps from open to close - orderMinutes; a slot is unavailable when for any 15-min step booked appointments + pets in the order > capacities.grooming, or the chosen groomer is busy; today's past times are "Too soon" (R-X15, R-G21).
Changing location or groomer clears the chosen time.

spec.name: Summary & payment
spec.purpose: Step 4: review when / where / who, per-pet package and add-ons, pick card or pay at location, see engine totals (tax, card fee) and pay. Creates the order, appointments, invoice, payment and notification.
layout: ServicePayMethod (card fields or Stripe mount | pay at location)
logic: quoteOrder(): one quoteGrooming per pet (package for size + add-ons), service tax on the sum, card fee only for card (R-H03, R-H04, R-G15).
PaymentProvider.createPaymentIntent for card; last4 0002 declines (mock).
Status: vaccines missing -> pending_vaccines; card paid -> confirmed; pay at location -> requested (R-A05).
Writes grooming_orders, one appointments row per pet, invoices (+ payments when card), notifications; clears the draft; opens C-55 with ?new=1.

spec.name: Your Grooming & Spa orders
spec.purpose: History of Grooming & Spa orders split into upcoming and past, each re-creatable in one tap; entry to a new order.
logic: Upcoming = active statuses starting later than 3 h ago, ascending; past = the rest, newest first.
Re-create = same as C-55.

spec.name: Order detail & confirmation
spec.purpose: One Grooming & Spa order: confirmation state right after booking, status in the one lifecycle, per-pet lines, location, groomer, payment and invoice totals; re-create it or cancel before confirmation.
layout: Details card (status, location, groomer, chair time, payment, invoice, notes)
Actions: Re-create | Cancel booking / Message the front desk
logic: Customer labels via BOOKING_STATUS_CUSTOMER_LABEL (Pending verification, Upcoming, Completed).
Re-create writes a draft with the same pets, packages, add-ons, location and groomer, then opens C-53 for a new time (R-G16).
Cancel allowed only in requested / pending_vaccines (R-X14): sets order and appointments to cancelled and notifies; otherwise offers the front desk chat.

spec.name: Daycare
spec.purpose: Entry point of Daycare: what it is, live pricing (full day, half day, play hour, walk with the hour threshold and the extra-pet discount), upcoming days and Book now. Replaces the "Coming soon" placeholder (R-A03).
logic: Threshold hours come from the full_day row (fallback half_day).
Upcoming = date >= today and active status, first 3.
Book now resets the daycare draft with the customer's home location.

spec.name: Daycare reservation
spec.purpose: Step 1: pick pets, location and day, set drop-off and pick-up times and see the computed price live; the day length decides whether grooming can be added (R-X02 / R-X17).
layout: Add-grooming toggle or "no time for grooming" notice
logic: hours = check_out - check_in; quoteDaycare(hours, pets): full day at/above threshold, half day below, play hour at 1 h or less; extra-pet discount per additional pet (R-F01..F06).
Times are clamped to the location's hours, check-out at least 1 h after check-in (R-X16).
groomingFitMinutes = shortest package for the pets' sizes + settings.daycare.grooming_buffer_min (default 60); day >= fit offers the add-grooming toggle, otherwise explains (R-X17).

spec.name: Additional pet details
spec.purpose: Step 2: per selected pet, vet-recommended flea medication (brand, last applied) and medical alerts for the handlers.
layout: One collapsible Section per pet: flea medication select, brand + date, medical alerts textarea (100 chars), on-file notice
logic: Answers live in draft.details[petId] and are written to daycare_booking_pets at checkout.
Brand and date only when flea medication = Yes.
Redirects to C-61 when no pets or day are set.

spec.name: Daycare checkout
spec.purpose: Step 3: summary of day, times, location and pets, payment method, engine totals and pay. The Figma checkout was empty (DayCare-3), so this is designed to match the grooming checkout.
logic: quoteDaycare with payWithCard for the card fee; service tax rate (R-H03, R-H04).
Status per statusFor(): pending_vaccines / confirmed / requested (R-A05).
Writes daycare_bookings, one daycare_booking_pets row per pet, invoices (+ payments), notifications; clears the draft; opens C-64 with ?new=1.

spec.name: Your daycare days
spec.purpose: History of daycare days split into upcoming and past; book any day again in one tap.
logic: Upcoming = date >= today with an active status, ascending; past = the rest, newest first.

spec.name: Daycare day detail
spec.purpose: One daycare day: confirmation right after booking, status, pets with their questionnaire answers, payment and totals; book again, cancel before confirmation, or add grooming when the day is long enough.
layout: Actions: Book again | Cancel / Message the front desk
logic: Book again prefills the daycare draft (pets, times, location, questionnaire) and opens C-61.
Book grooming prefills the grooming draft with the same pets, date and location and opens C-51 (R-X17).
Cancel only in requested / pending_vaccines (R-X14).

spec.name: My pets
spec.purpose: Every active pet of the household in a grid with photo, breed, weight and approval / vaccine status; entry point to add a pet or open a profile.
logic: Active pets only (pets.status != inactive) ordered by created_at.
Card status from petApproval(); tapping opens /app/pets/:petId.
Grid: 2 columns on phones, 3 at >= 600 px inside the phone column.

spec.name: Add pet wizard
spec.purpose: Five clean steps to add a dog: Basics (photo, name, type, breed, sex, neutered, colour, date of birth), Size (weight in lbs with the computed size band), Personality & feeding, Vet & emergency contact, Vaccines (per required / recommended vaccine: date, expiry, proof). Resolves the duplicated Figma steps into one stepper.
layout: Step 1 Basics (PetPhotoPicker, Input, Select x5, date)
Step 2 Size & weight (Input lbs, size band card)
Step 3 Personality & feeding (Checkbox group, RadioGroup, Select, Textarea x3)
Step 4 Vet & emergency (Select vets + add, Input name/phone/relationship, Textarea conditions/allergies)
Step 5 Vaccines (VaccineRecordRow x5 + VaccineRecordForm, pending warning)
logic: Required basics: name, type, sex, neutered (R-C01); Next is blocked with inline errors until valid.
Weight in lbs -> size = sizeFromWeightLbs(weight) shown live and saved (R-C02, R-X21).
Meals per day is slot based (R-C04); feeding instructions per slot (R-C05).
Breed / colour selects come from pet_lookups; "Add another" inserts a row (entities 5). Vet select + "Add a vet" inserts a vets row (R-B08).

Submit: insert pets (approval pending, or needs_details when vaccines are skipped, R-X25), upsert emergency_contacts, insert vaccine_records (status submitted) for each drafted vaccine, notify the customer (pet_added) and the front desk of the home location (vaccine_submitted) when proofs were uploaded.
Skip on the vaccines step is allowed (R-B07) and shows the pending warning (R-A05).
integrations: Company-OS file storage (later; proofs and photos are mock URLs / data URLs now)
notes: Type defaults to Dog; other species are allowed in the select but all copy says dog (open question 25 -> decision pending).

spec.name: Pet profile
spec.purpose: Everything about one pet: photo, name, breed, approval status, stats (sex, age, weight and size band), vaccine summary with a link to the records, care and feeding, medical and vet, emergency contact, upcoming bookings; edit or remove the pet.
layout: VaccinesSection (VaccineStatusChip per type, link to C-21)
CareSection (personality, socialised with, food, meals, treats, feeding notes)
logic: Only the owner household (or a staff preview) can open a pet; other ids redirect to My pets.
Approval badge = petApproval(); vaccine chips = petVaccineSummary() (R-X20).
Remove = soft delete (status inactive) after confirmation; blocked while the pet has an unfinished booking, appointment or daycare day (R-X24).
notes: The UI-kit Reminder / Notes concept is not built (open question 26); care notes come from the pet record instead.

spec.name: Edit pet
spec.purpose: The same five-step wizard prefilled with the pet, with a Save on every step; vaccine records edited here are saved immediately as submitted.
logic: Loads the pet, its emergency contact and vaccine records into the wizard state.

Save updates pets (size recomputed, R-X21), upserts the emergency contact, inserts / updates vaccine_records for changed drafts; approval_status is not touched unless a required vaccine was newly uploaded (pending) - staff approve.
Owner check as C-13.
notes: The Figma "Pet Profile (edit)" mixed owner fields into the pet form; here the form is pet-only (open question 27).

spec.name: Pet vaccine records
spec.purpose: All vaccine records of one pet with verification state, dates and proofs; upload or update each record and see the history of earlier records.
logic: Current record per type = latest vaccinated_on; older rows show under History.
Updating a verified record inserts a new submitted record (the verified one stays in history) so staff verify the new proof (R-B03).
Statuses per R-X20.

spec.name: Vaccines
spec.purpose: Choose a pet, see each vaccine's status and upload proofs: the customer side of the vaccine flow that gates bookings (pending_vaccines until the front desk verifies).
layout: PetSelector (PetAvatarCard x n with status chip and next expiry)
logic: Selected pet defaults to the first pet needing attention (worst status), else the first pet.

Upload / Update opens VaccineRecordForm; Save inserts a vaccine_records row (status submitted, proof_url mock) or updates the existing one; a vaccine_submitted notification goes to the front desk user of the customer's home location.
Statuses per R-X20; chips on the pet cards show the worst required status and the earliest upcoming expiry.
notes: Resolves open question 32: one proof per vaccine record (per-vaccine uploads), not one bulk upload.
The Figma pet-card date (3-03-2024) is read as the earliest upcoming expiry (open question 35).

spec.name: Hotel: choose pets & dates
spec.purpose: First step of a hotel stay: pick the location, the pets that are coming, whether they share a room, and the check-in / check-out days and times on a range calendar bounded by opening hours.
layout: Pet cards (BookingPetCard, multi-select, approval + vaccine chips)
logic: R-A01: no pets -> EmptyState with Add a pet.
Share-room question only for 2+ pets; more than settings.max_pets_per_room forces separate rooms (R-X53).
validateStay(): check-out after check-in, min nights, times inside location hours for that weekday, closed days disabled (R-X54).
Vaccine chip per pet from vaccine_records vs required vaccine_types (R-A05).
Draft persists in localStorage (petrock.hotelDraft.v1) across steps and refreshes.
notes: Chosen over the text-input variant: the room-share question is a Yes/No select (open question 39).
Grooming is its own step (C-33) instead of the Yes/No dropdown on this screen.

spec.name: Hotel: choose room type
spec.purpose: Pick Penthouse or Suite for the chosen pets and dates. Cards show the inclusions copy, the average nightly rate per pet from the pricing engine, rooms left, and are disabled by the fit rules (55 lb Suite only, 30 lb bottom rooms) or when the location is full.
logic: avgNightly(): quoteHotel for 1 dog over the dates / nights (R-X59, weekday / weekend / seasonal rates R-D05, R-D06).
roomFit(): any pet >= 55 lb blocks Penthouse (R-X01); pets >= 30 lb need a bottom penthouse room (R-E09, R-X57).
availability(): capacities.max_simultaneous minus overlapping active stays; rooms needed = 1 when sharing else pets count (R-X56, R-E11, R-E12).
notes: Suite description is its own copy (the Figma card repeats the Penthouse text).
Prices are never hardcoded: $150 / $105 / $115 in the exports were conflicting placeholders (open question 48).

spec.name: Hotel: pet stay details
spec.purpose: Per pet coming to stay: feeding plan, own food, medication and dosing, vet-recommended flea medication (brand, last dose), belongings, medical alert and notes. Prefilled from the pet profile.
layout: One collapsible Section per pet (BookingPetCard compact header)
logic: Defaults from pets.feeding_am / feeding_pm / own_food / medical_conditions.
Medication and flea sub-fields appear only when the answer is Yes (R-A10).
Saved into booking_pets (medical) and booking_pet_care (feeding, belongings, flea) at payment.
notes: Resolves open question 42: the form is per pet (one section each), titled once; the unlabeled date is the last flea dose.

spec.name: Hotel: add grooming during the stay
spec.purpose: Optionally add one Grooming & Spa package (Gold / Platinum / Diamond priced by the pet size) plus add-ons per pet, scheduled at the end of the stay. Skippable.
layout: Info band (grooms at the end of stays)
Per pet: package RadioGroup cards with size price, add-on Chips
logic: packagePrice(pkg, pet.size) from packages.price_<size> (R-G01, R-G02); add-ons from addons with starting-at flag (R-G10, R-G11).
quoteGrooming() per pet (service tax); appointments are created at payment with booking_id and 09:00 on check-out day (R-X55, R-A09).

spec.name: Hotel: customer details
spec.purpose: Confirm the contact and billing details for the stay: names, mobile and alternate phone, email, US address. Prefilled from the customer record and written back on payment.
layout: Two-column rows: first / last name, mobile / alt phone
logic: Required: first, last, mobile, email, address, city, state, zip; email and ZIP format checks.
One address serves contact and billing (open question 44).

spec.name: Hotel: estimate
spec.purpose: Pre-payment estimate: room line items by night kind and season, multi-dog and long-stay discounts, tax, grooming, then the two payment paths (deposit or full) with the card fee shown for the amount charged now.
layout: Payment method RadioGroup (card / cash at location)
Grooming HotelEstimateCard or Add grooming band
Payment details card (hotel, grooming, total, due now, fee, balance)
Sticky footer: Pay deposit / Pay in full
logic: buildHotelQuote(): one room with N dogs when sharing, else one room per pet (R-X53); quoteHotel per room (R-D05, R-E01..E06).
Long-stay discount only when paid in full and no holiday nights; the engine note explains why it did not apply (R-E04..E06, R-E08, R-E15).
Tax: boarding rate on stays, service rate on grooming (R-H04, R-H05).
depositFor(): settings.hotel_booking.deposit_percent of the pre-fee total (R-X50).
chargeFor(): card fee percent from fees on the amount charged now (R-H03, R-X58).
notes: Merges the two Estimate variants: Payment Details card AND the card-fee footnote (open question 46).

spec.name: Hotel: payment
spec.purpose: Charge the deposit or the full amount with a Stripe-shaped card form through the PaymentProvider (mock today), or record cash at location; then create the booking, its pets, care notes, grooming appointments, invoice, payment and notification.
layout: Amount due card (due now, fee, balance)
logic: validateCard(): Luhn, expiry, CVC, name, ZIP; last4 0002 declines in the mock.
createPaymentIntent(amountCents, method) then confirm; failure shows the provider error and keeps the draft.
initialStatusFor(): requested, or pending_vaccines when any pet is not verified (R-X51, R-A05).
Booking code PR-<next>, invoice INV-<next> from existing rows / settings.invoice.next_number (R-H09); invoice balance = total - charged.
Grooming appointments: one per pet with booking_id, 09:00 on check-out day, requested (R-X55).
Customer row updated with the details from C-34; draft cleared on success.
integrations: PaymentProvider (MockPaymentProvider now; StripePaymentProvider + PaymentElement later, no keys)

spec.name: Hotel: confirmation
spec.purpose: After payment: the booking code, the current status on the lifecycle timeline, what happens next (vaccine proofs, desk confirmation, balance at check-in) and links to the reservation and home.
layout: Actions: View reservation, Back to home
logic: pending_vaccines -> call-out to upload proofs (R-A05); requested -> desk confirms (R-I04 Pending verification / Upcoming).

spec.name: My reservations
spec.purpose: Every reservation of the pet parent in one list: hotel stays, Grooming & Spa appointments and daycare days, split into Upcoming and Previous, filterable by kind; tapping a stay opens its detail.
layout: Kind filter Chips (All / Hotel / Grooming / Daycare)
logic: Upcoming = end (check-out / appointment / day) in the future and status not checked_out / cancelled / no_show; else Previous.
Sorted by start ascending (upcoming) / descending (previous).
Balance due chip from the invoice when > 0.
notes: Grooming and daycare cards have no detail link until their modules register /app/grooming/:id and /app/daycare/:id.

spec.name: Reservation detail
spec.purpose: One stay in full: status timeline, dates, pets with vaccine state and care notes, linked grooming, payment summary with balance, open change requests, and the actions to request a change or cancel.
layout: Pets Section (BookingPetCard compact, vaccine chip, care notes)
Sticky footer: Request change / Cancel stay
logic: Customer may cancel requested / pending_vaccines stays directly (status -> cancelled, approved change request logged); confirmed stays file an open cancel request for the desk (manager PIN there, R-I06); checked_in and later cannot be cancelled here (R-X52).
Free-cancellation window from settings.hotel_booking.free_cancellation_hours shown in the modal.
Balance = invoice.balance; without an invoice, total - deposit.
figma: front desk-5.jpg (booking detail, ported per D-010)

spec.name: Reservation invoice
spec.purpose: Printable invoice for a stay: line items, discounts, tax, card fee, total, deposit paid and balance due, payments made, footer. Print button.
logic: Falls back to the booking quote when no invoice row exists yet (cash bookings before the desk issues one).
Footer and title from settings.invoice (R-H10); tax number from taxes (R-H05).

spec.name: Request a change
spec.purpose: Ask the front desk to modify a stay: new dates, add or remove a pet, add grooming, or something else, with a message. Creates a booking_change_requests row and notifies the desk at that location.
logic: Only for stays that are requested, pending_vaccines or confirmed (R-X52).
Modify dates validates like C-30 (R-X54).
Staff notification to front_desk users of the booking location.

spec.name: Profile hub
spec.purpose: The Settings tab of the customer app: photo, name and email, then the account menu (edit profile, pets, payment methods, notifications, chat, app settings, help, rate, about, log out).
logic: useCustomerAccount resolves the customer behind the user; staff previewing falls back to the demo customer.
Unread notification and chat counts as badges.
Photo picker stores a data URL in users.avatar_url (mock upload, 1.5 MB cap).
Log out = signOut() then /auth/sign-in.

spec.name: Edit profile
spec.purpose: Edit contact details and address; email and password change through separate confirmation flows.
layout: Sign-in (email read-only + Change email modal; password disabled + Change password link)
logic: Required: first, last, mobile; phone and ZIP format checks.
Save updates customers and mirrors name / phone to users.
Change email asks for the new address and the current password (mock), writes audit_log email.change.

spec.name: App settings
spec.purpose: Device and account settings: language, dark mode, colour theme, notification preferences, change password, payment methods, delete account.
layout: Appearance (language row, dark mode toggle, colour theme segmented)
Account (notifications, password, payment methods, delete account)
logic: Dark mode and brand write through ThemeProvider (localStorage petrock.theme).
Language row shows the current language and opens C-73.

spec.name: Language
spec.purpose: Pick the app language (English, Español) and save it on the device and on the account.
logic: Save is disabled until the choice differs; on save setLang() + users.preferred_language.
Every module string has en / es entries; missing es falls back to en.

spec.name: Payment methods
spec.purpose: Saved cards for faster deposits: list, add (tokenised), make default, remove; cash at the location stays available.
layout: Add card modal (name, number, expiry, CVC, ZIP, default)
logic: Brand detected from the number prefix, Luhn check, expiry MM/YY not in the past, 3-4 digit CVC, 5-digit ZIP.
Only brand, last4, expiry, holder and a provider token are stored (R-M22).
One default per customer; removing the default promotes the next card; removed cards keep status removed for invoices.

spec.name: Notification preferences
spec.purpose: Choose per category (bookings, vaccines, chat, payments, offers) which channels (push, email, SMS) reach you.
layout: Matrix card (category rows x channel toggles)
logic: Missing rows are created with defaults on first open (offers off, bookings on everywhere).
Each toggle saves immediately.

spec.name: Delete account
spec.purpose: App-store required flow: explain the 30-day grace period, block on active bookings, collect a reason, require typing DELETE, then schedule the deletion and sign out.
logic: Blocked while any booking is requested / pending_vaccines / confirmed / checked_in.
Insert account_deletion_requests (requested, scheduled_for = today + 30) and audit_log account.delete_requested; signOut(); go to sign-in.
A pending request can be cancelled from the same screen.

spec.name: Help & support
spec.purpose: Get help: chat with the Front Desk, call a location, browse the FAQ by topic, send a support request and see past requests with staff replies.
layout: Contact us (chat, call per location, website)
logic: Support request needs a topic and 10+ characters; stored with the home location for the desk.
Phone rows use tel: links (R-M11 replaces voice / video calls).

spec.name: About & legal
spec.purpose: App version, legal documents, our locations with today's hours, rate and delete links, company footer.
logic: Version from package.json (__APP_VERSION__).
Hours for today from locations.hours; address opens Maps.

spec.name: Legal document
spec.purpose: Reads a published legal document (privacy policy, terms of service, licences) with version and effective date.
logic: Looked up by slug; unpublished or unknown slug shows an EmptyState.

spec.name: Notification centre
spec.purpose: All in-app notifications grouped by day with an unread filter and mark-all-read; the Inbox tab shows the Front Desk threads.
logic: Tap marks read and follows notifications.link; dismiss removes the row.
Relative times per R-M08; groups Today / Yesterday / weekday / date.

spec.name: Inbox
spec.purpose: The Chat tab: one Front Desk conversation per location with preview, time and unread count; locations without a thread offer to start one.
logic: Starting a thread inserts conversations + a system "Session start" message.
Preview shows "You:" when the last message is the customer's.

spec.name: Front Desk chat
spec.purpose: Message the Front Desk of one location: day markers, bubbles with read receipts, photo attachments, quick replies, typing indicator and a demo staff reply.
logic: Opening marks staff messages read and zeroes unread_customer (R-M24).
Send inserts the message, updates the conversation preview and unread_staff; a mock staff reply follows in ~3 s and marks the customer's messages Seen.
Bubbles within 5 minutes from the same sender are grouped; own messages right in primary (R-M25).
Images: jpg / png / webp up to 2 MB as data URLs (R-M28).

spec.name: Rate the app
spec.purpose: Leave a star rating, tags and a comment; the owner moderates it before it appears on the website.
logic: Insert reviews (status pending, rating 1-5, tags).
Store review prompt is a placeholder until Capacitor.
integrations: App Store / Play review sheet (Capacitor) later

spec.name: Change password
spec.purpose: Change the account password with a strength meter and rule checklist; other devices are signed out.
layout: Card (current, forgot link, new + strength, repeat)
logic: New password needs score >= 2 (8+ chars, letter + number), must differ from current and match the repeat.
Mock check; writes audit_log password.change.

spec.name: Page specs index
spec.purpose: Every route with its page code, surface, built / stub status, roles and spec completeness; opens the inspector for any spec.
logic: specCompleteness(spec) scores 8 checks.
status = PageStub element ? stub : built

spec.name: Design tokens
spec.purpose: Every design value in one place: brand palettes (Petrock purple, Sunset), neutrals, semantic roles per theme, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, motion, booking status hues. Generated into tokens.css.
logic: buildTokensCss() renders :root + [data-brand] x [data-theme] blocks; ThemeProvider sets the attributes.

spec.name: Component library
spec.purpose: Every component with its meta: description, props, states, live usages, accessibility notes, pages that use it and Figma source. Rule: no component without a meta.
logic: componentLibrary globs src/components/**/*.meta.ts.

spec.name: Page specs index
spec.purpose: Every route with its page code, surface, built / stub status, roles and spec completeness; opens the inspector for any spec.
logic: specCompleteness(spec) scores 8 checks.
status = PageStub element ? stub : built

spec.name: Table library
spec.purpose: Every table in the schema grouped by area with row counts, columns and access notes, plus the generic table manager that lists, adds, edits and deletes rows of any table (delete is PIN-gated).
logic: tableRegistry from src/data/schema/*.ts
Base columns (id, location_id, created_at, updated_at) are read-only in the editor.
Delete asks for a manager PIN (R-P01) and writes approvals + audit_log.

spec.name: Table library
spec.purpose: Every table in the schema grouped by area with row counts, columns and access notes, plus the generic table manager that lists, adds, edits and deletes rows of any table (delete is PIN-gated).
logic: tableRegistry from src/data/schema/*.ts
Base columns (id, location_id, created_at, updated_at) are read-only in the editor.
Delete asks for a manager PIN (R-P01) and writes approvals + audit_log.

spec.name: Business rules registry
spec.purpose: Every business rule with id, category, status (requested / in dev / implemented / deprecated), the pages that use it and its source; owners add new rules here (Settings › Rules) and each page inspector links back.
logic: Code registry (src/rules/*.ts) merged with runtime rows from the rules table; runtime rows win on id.
Adding a rule needs rules.write.

spec.name: Knowledge base
spec.purpose: Kanban, changelog (including pending module drafts) and prompt log in tabs; the project memory.
logic: Changelog header lines (version, date, prompt, codes) are parsed by headerMeta().

spec.name: Component states matrix
spec.purpose: Every component against every quality signal in one grid: tier, number of states, usages, props documented, accessibility notes, pages that use it, Figma source. Gaps (no a11y notes, no usage, unused on any page) are flagged so the library stays honest (R-X81).
layout: StatTiles (components, with a11y notes, used on a page, gaps)
logic: componentLibrary from src/design/library.ts (globbed metas).
gap = no usages, or no a11y notes, or usedBy empty.
coverage % = components without gaps / total.

spec.name: Spec completeness report
spec.purpose: For every route: the fields its PageSpec is missing, references that do not resolve (tables not in the schema, components without a meta, rule ids not in the registry), widths not yet checked (D-016), stubs, duplicate or out-of-range page codes and pages without a menu entry. Export as markdown for docs/qa (R-X80).
layout: ReportTable (DataTable, one row per route, issues listed)
logic: buildSpecReport(getRoutes()) in specReport.ts.
Module of a route = the registry module whose routes array contains it.
Expected module per code from CODE_RANGES (docs/build-plan.md).

spec.name: Data workbench
spec.purpose: The table manager with power tools: inline editing of any editable cell, relations (what this table references and what references it, with one-click row filters), CSV export of the current view and CSV import (insert / upsert) with header mapping and type coercion. Deletes and bulk imports need a manager PIN and every write is audited (R-X84).
layout: PageHeader (table picker, export, import, add row)
TableIndex (cards with relation counts) when no table is chosen
WorkbenchTable (DataTable with InlineCell per column, enum filters, relation filter chip)
logic: Editable cell types from ColumnDef: text, int/numeric/money -> number, bool, enum, date, json; base columns read-only (R-J03).
Relation filter: ?ref=<column>:<id> narrows rows to those pointing at one row.
Import: insert regenerates ids; upsert updates rows whose id exists. More than one row -> PIN first.
Every insert / update / delete writes audit_log with the diff.

spec.name: Data workbench
spec.purpose: The table manager with power tools: inline editing of any editable cell, relations (what this table references and what references it, with one-click row filters), CSV export of the current view and CSV import (insert / upsert) with header mapping and type coercion. Deletes and bulk imports need a manager PIN and every write is audited (R-X84).
layout: PageHeader (table picker, export, import, add row)
TableIndex (cards with relation counts) when no table is chosen
WorkbenchTable (DataTable with InlineCell per column, enum filters, relation filter chip)

spec.name: Layout editor
spec.purpose: Reorder and hide the sections a page declares in its spec.layout, per page code, saved to page_layouts. Pages that call useLayout(spec) render in that order; the spec keeps the section names. Reset returns to the spec order (R-X83).
layout: PageList (routes with customised badge) when no code is chosen
Preview (numbered section outline as the page will render)
logic: applyLayout(spec, row): saved order first, new spec sections appended, hidden filtered to existing names.
Save = update the page_layouts row or insert one; reset = delete it.
Dirty state compares against the saved row.

spec.name: Layout editor
spec.purpose: Reorder and hide the sections a page declares in its spec.layout, per page code, saved to page_layouts. Pages that call useLayout(spec) render in that order; the spec keeps the section names. Reset returns to the spec order (R-X83).
layout: PageList (routes with customised badge) when no code is chosen
Preview (numbered section outline as the page will render)
logic: applyLayout(spec, row): saved order first, new spec sections appended, hidden filtered to existing names.
Save = update the page_layouts row or insert one; reset = delete it.
Dirty state compares against the saved row.

spec.name: Seed inspector
spec.purpose: What the mock database holds: rows per table, the twelve months of history the dev-quality seed adds (stays, grooms, daycare days, invoices, revenue by month), date coverage, localStorage size, seed version, and reseed. Proves reports have a year of data (R-X86).
layout: StatTiles (tables, rows, bookings, invoices, revenue, storage)
MonthlyCharts (stays, appointments, daycare days, revenue by month)
CoverageTable (per table: rows, first / last created_at, location split)
logic: Months from check_in / starts_at / date over the last 12 months.
Revenue = sum of paid invoices.total per issued_at month.
Storage = JSON.stringify(localStorage petrock.db.v1).length / 1024.

spec.name: Route manifest
spec.purpose: The registry as tooling sees it: every route with module, surface, shell, roles, menu group, params, stub / built, screenshot coverage and code-range check; duplicates and collisions; the window.__petrock manifest as JSON to download for scripts. Hardens what scripts/screenshots.mjs and qa-responsive.mjs consume.
layout: StatTiles (routes, modules, stubs, with nav, parameterised)
Collisions (same path or code across modules)
logic: buildManifest(getRoutes()) from src/app/manifest.ts plus module names from getModules().
Collision = two modules registering one path (registry kept the built one) or one code on two names.

spec.name: Responsive QA report
spec.purpose: The matrix of every route at 360, 390, 768, 1280 and 1920 px in light and dark, as scripts/qa-responsive.mjs last measured it: horizontal scroll, elements that overflow the viewport, console errors and a11y findings per cell. Click a cell for the offenders. Runs are logged in qa_runs (R-X82, D-016).
layout: StatTiles (routes, cells, failing cells, a11y findings)
CellDrawer (offenders, a11y, errors, open in preview)
logic: Report from docs/qa/responsive-report.json (bundled).
cell fail = hscroll or console error; warn = a11y findings only; pass otherwise.
Cells missing from the report show as not checked.

spec.name: Responsive preview
spec.purpose: Any route side by side at the five D-016 widths (or one width at full size) in same-origin iframes, so a builder can check a page at 360 and 1920 without resizing the browser. Picks the route from the manifest; shares the current theme and session.
logic: Frames load ./#<route> and scale down to fit their column; one-width mode renders unscaled with horizontal scroll.
Parameterised routes use sample params (:table -> bookings, :code -> D-03).

spec.name: Accessibility scan
spec.purpose: Loads a route in a same-origin iframe and runs the a11y checks (images without alt, controls without a name, unlabelled inputs, iframe titles, heading order, main landmark, positive tabindex, tiny targets, html lang) live; lists findings with selector and WCAG criterion. The same checks run headless in the responsive QA script (R-X87).
layout: RulesLegend (what each rule checks and its WCAG criterion)
logic: scanA11y(iframe.contentDocument) after load + 400 ms.
Findings capped at 200 per page.

spec.name: Performance budget
spec.purpose: Bundle sizes from the last build (scripts/qa-bundle.mjs writes docs/qa/bundle-report.json) and runtime numbers measured now (seed build time, localStorage size, route count, first render) against the perf_budgets table. Budgets are rows, not constants (R-X85).
logic: bundle metrics from bundle-report.json: js_total_kb, css_total_kb, largest_chunk_kb, assets_count_max, docs_kb.
runtime: seed_ms = time of buildSeed(); localstorage_kb from the persisted db; route_count_max from the manifest; first_render_ms from performance timing.
status: fail > 100 %, warn >= warn_at_percent.

spec.name: Screenshot diff
spec.purpose: Every page code with its captured screenshots: which widths and themes exist, which are missing, and a before / after comparison (split, side by side, blend) between the current capture and one taken with --label=before. Coverage per page code drives the definition of done.
layout: StatTiles (codes with shots, complete, missing dark, without shots)
CompareCard (ImageCompare for the chosen code + width)
logic: Assets from import.meta.glob docs/screenshots/**/*.jpg; file name <width>[-dark][-<label>].jpg.
